title: DMHO Ri-Bhoi Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for 20 Staff Nurse Posts
description: Office of the District Medical & Health Officer, Ri-Bhoi District, Nongpoh, Government of Meghalaya (DMHO Ri-Bhoi), has declared the official notification for the recruitment of 20 Staff Nurse Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in the GNM, B.Sc. Nursing can use this chance and apply for the DMHO Ri-Bhoi Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible can...
